article.title: Summons to defendants.
article.content:
27Summons to defendants.

Section 27
Summons and discovery
Where a suit has been duly instituted, a summons may be issued to the defendant to appear and answer the claim and may be served in manner prescribed 3[on such day not beyond thirty days from date of the institution of the suit.]

3 Ins. by s. 3, ibid., (w.e.f. 1-7-2002).
